hypothesis: The remaining admission residuals include fixed work shared across nonempty batches. Replacing the weak running-count feature with a nonempty indicator should explain this work while preserving the successful linear and small-batch terms. Empty-queue residuals were already below 10 percent.

pcvs.name: waiting_requests
pcvs.rationale: Captures approximately linear per-request admission work.

pcvs.name: single_waiting_request
pcvs.rationale: Retains the distinct singleton admission regime supported by previous measurements.

pcvs.name: two_waiting_requests
pcvs.rationale: Retains the distinct two-request admission regime.

pcvs.name: nonempty_waiting
pcvs.rationale: Captures fixed admission-path costs shared by all nonempty batches, independently of the empty-queue baseline.
